market_overview: Across the evidence set, sentiment is mixed but leans bullish on commodities such as gold, oil and the U.S. dollar, while equity and AI coverage remains neutral to bearish. Geopolitical risk and central‑bank policy surface repeatedly, driving divergent views especially in oil and rates. The global PSI sits at 54 (Mixed/Neutral) with the U.S. market showing bullish bias (PSI 59). Top‑mover reversals in AUD, NVDA, NZD and S&P suggest short‑term volatility, but no single narrative dominates the cross‑market picture.

Kitco News frames the rally as technical strength, while The Block highlights sanctions risk as bearish, and MarketWatch offers a neutral view. Central‑bank policy, currency moves and geopolitical risk are the most cited themes.

topic_insights.confidence_note: Broad outlet coverage (30 sources) and multiple themes give a solid base, though conflicting coverage lowers absolute certainty.
